### God’s Promise to David
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-march-11-2025.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 7:16
Points:
- David wanted to build a temple for God, but God told him that his son Solomon would do it instead.
- God responded to David with an enduring covenant promising an everlasting dynasty and kingdom.
- The eternal throne promised to David points forward directly to the Messiah, Jesus Christ.
- God often uses trials and periods of waiting to shape His servants before calling them to greater tasks.

### Day 49: 2 Samuel 7:17
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-49-2-samuel-7-17.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 7:17
Points:
- God establishes accountability for leaders through His word and prophets rather than unchecked authority.
- Good intentions and noble ideas from godly people are not always God's actual direction.
- Nathan and David had to learn not to presume that chosen leaders are always right.
- God prepared Nathan to deliver divine truth faithfully rather than merely endorsing a king's plans.

### Building David's House
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/building-davids-house
Passage: 2 Samuel 7:12-13
Points:
- David desired to build a house for God, but God revealed He would establish a house for David.
- The Davidic covenant is rooted purely in God's sovereign grace rather than human achievement.
- God promised rest for His people and fatherly discipline without removing His steadfast love.
- The promise of an eternal ruler over God's people is ultimately fulfilled in Jesus Christ.
